cases.rawBody: Step 2: install toolset version 4.2.1 in ${WORKSPACE}/envs/annotation-4.2.1. Keep the reference database at ${WORKSPACE}/refs/current-db and create the required symlink ${WORKSPACE}/db -> ${WORKSPACE}/refs/current-db; do not copy the large database. Build the annotation database with make-db --input ${WORKSPACE}/inputs/variants.vcf --output ${WORKSPACE}/db/annotation.db. Run the smoke test make-db --check ${WORKSPACE}/db/annotation.db and report the installed version and resolved symlink target.

constraints: Use the declared environment and symlink; do not copy the reference database.
stopConditions: Stop if the declared environment is unavailable.
